morbi.headline: Morbi tile sector faces margin pressures from propane price hikes despite strong housing demand.
what_changed: Tile sector outperformed peer segments driven by favorable gas costs and housing demand [edc2b0a0e70b].

improvement_signals: Sector outperformance supported by realized price hikes and robust housing demand [edc2b0a0e70b].
what_to_watch: Resolution of the propane price dispute and IOCL boycott by Morbi ceramic units.
Sustainability of tile price hikes against escalating input costs.
Account-level working capital utilization and margin impact assessments.

surat.headline: Textiles anticipate wedding demand amid payment defaults; diamond sector faces cost and fraud pressures.
what_changed: Surat textile units expect a 15-20% demand increase driven by the upcoming marriage season.
Lab-grown rough diamond prices rose 10% due to Chinese measures, elevating local production costs.
SGCCI demanded BNS amendments to curb rising multi-crore payment defaults and financial fraud in textiles.
stress_signals: Broker fraud in Katargam resulting in the loss of 1,035 carats of polished diamonds worth Rs 1.27 crore [e8488d4182be].
Rising payment defaults and fraud incidents in Surat's textile market prompting industry intervention [c3927b4b71cd].
Input cost pressure on lab-grown diamond polishers due to a 10% price hike in rough supply [9cbc45a9c3f9].
Operational disruption following a factory fire at Sachin GIDC [386760347e06].
improvement_signals: Surat textile industry projects 15-20% growth during the upcoming marriage season [ee10e4ca8235].
Export opportunities invited for textiles in Afghanistan via a Surat expo [750daf4642ee].
what_to_watch: Government decisions on extending textile machinery duty exemptions to prevent a potential 9.74% tax burden [c4aec41167e8].
Ability of lab-grown diamond units to pass on the 10% rough cost increase to end buyers.
Account-level receivables aging and payment realization rates in textile units amid reported market defaults.
Commercialization progress of R&D partnerships including Garden Silk Mills-MANTRA polymeric yarn trials [a09df64b91a6].
